verdict.rationale: E2B gives users mechanisms to terminate ('kill') or set timeouts on sandboxes, and paused sandboxes persist indefinitely until explicitly resumed or deleted, giving some control over sandbox lifecycle/data. However, there is no documentation on retention policies for logs, telemetry, or underlying storage, nor explicit deletion/export guarantees for user data beyond the sandbox itself; self-hosting (e2b-gh-2) offers a path to full control but isn't the default.
